mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust household demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals a contraction in corporate output and future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures and GDP growth above 2% annualized signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% combined with rising non-farm payrolls signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain higher rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 145000.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0%, signals a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, which reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: supply shock with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
